def _min_triangle_area(pts):
    """Compute the minimum area of any triangle formed by 3 of the N points.
    pts has shape (N, 2)."""
    pi = pts[_idx_i]
    pj = pts[_idx_j]
    pk = pts[_idx_k]
    # Area = 0.5 * |cross(pj-pi, pk-pi)|
    cross = (pj[:, 0] - pi[:, 0]) * (pk[:, 1] - pi[:, 1]) - \
            (pj[:, 1] - pi[:, 1]) * (pk[:, 0] - pi[:, 0])
    return 0.5 * np.min(np.abs(cross))

def _soft_min_triangle_area(pts, k=50.0):
    """Smooth surrogate: -logsumexp(k * areas) / k approximates -min(areas).
    As k -> inf, this converges to -min(areas)."""
    pi = pts[_idx_i]
    pj = pts[_idx_j]
    pk = pts[_idx_k]
    cross = (pj[:, 0] - pi[:, 0]) * (pk[:, 1] - pi[:, 1]) - \
            (pj[:, 1] - pi[:, 1]) * (pk[:, 0] - pi[:, 0])
    areas = 0.5 * np.abs(cross)
    # Soft min: -logsumexp(k * areas) / k
    max_a = np.max(areas)
    if max_a < 1e-15:
        return -1e-15
    log_sum = np.log(np.sum(np.exp(k * (areas - max_a)))) + k * max_a
    return -log_sum / k
